thread:
pd-bot: INCIDENT triggered: apigw_eu_502_spike — aggregated 502/504 rate ~28% over 5m in eu-west1. Auto-pager sent to SRE oncall. https://ops.redwood/incident/6601230000
ajones: oncall here, I'm joining. opening command-room, will start collection (graphs + logs)
nina: I'm on call as backup — grabbing live tail of ingress nginx and edge metrics
ingress-sre: seeing uptick in upstream timeouts to backend cluster-3, spike coincides with a surge in long-poll search requests
kevin: confirmed customer-facing impact: error traces show 502 for search and chat endpoints. Two enterprise customers reported errors via support (acme-corp, atlasco)
maria: adding customer-impact tag. status page? can we post an initial notification?
ajones: yes, draft: "We’re investigating elevated 5xx rates in EU, some requests may fail with 502/504. Working on mitigation." posting after we have mitigation plan
ops-bot: action: scaled up proxy pool +3 (target 20 -> 23) in eu-west1; cooldown 90s
kevin: tail from nginx shows upstream timed out around 60s, connection resets. snippet:
```
2026/03/17 09:12:01 [error] 12345#0: *987654 upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.2.3.4, server: _, request: "POST /v1/chat HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.4.5.6:8080/", host: "api.redwood.com"
```
ajones: looks like a backlog at backend workers causing connections to pile up. metrics: backend queue length spiked 4x, p95 processing time from 200ms -> 3.2s
nina: are there any recent deploys? checking deploy bot...
ops-bot: deploy-bot: no deploys to inference-backend in last 30m
kevin: possible root cause: sudden increase in long context chat requests and a small subset of requests causing KV cache misses, causing heavy backend CPU usage and slow responses
maria: mitigation suggestions: 1) enable temporary rate-limiter for anonymous endpoints; 2) route critical traffic to dedicated pool; 3) enable short-circuit fallback for non-blocking routes
ina: I can push a quick ingress rule to reject abusive clients by IP CIDR for 15m — will list top offenders first
ina: top offender CIDRs: 198.51.100.0/24 (bursting), 203.0.113.50 (single client heavy)
ajones: go ahead with CIDR block for 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.50, apply 429 with Retry-After 60s for now
ops-bot: applied WAF rule: block 198.51.100.0/24 (429) — rollout success
kevin: also enabling routing fallback: route /v1/embeddings and /v1/chat-lite to cpu-fallback pool (less performant but more stable)
ops-bot: routing rule change pushed, verifying health checks
ingress-sre: health checks showing backend pods recovering; error rate dropped from 28% -> 9% within 2 minutes of routing change
kevin: good signal. start gradual traffic shift back to gpu-pool after stabilization window of 5m
maria: customer comms: posted initial PS update: "We’re mitigating an issue causing 502/504 errors in EU. Customers experiencing errors may see degraded performance. Working on recovery, will update within 15 minutes."
ajones: can someone collect a sample of failing request IDs for post-incident analysis? query: status=502 AND region=eu-west1 AND ts > 6601229800
nina: grabbing IDs now, posting to command-room doc
kevin: note: circuit-breaker for backend service triggered earlier, need to tune CB thresholds to avoid thrash on small bursts
ajones: action items: (1) postmortem owner (kevin), (2) tune circuit-breaker + add KV cache telemetry (nina), (3) create runbook step for routing-to-fallback (maria)
maria: assigning and creating calendar invite for 30m postmortem sync
ingress-sre: final check — error rate stable at 4.6% last 1m, p99 latency improving. Keeping oncall open for 45m monitoring window
pd-bot: INCIDENT update: status=\"mitigated\" (degraded). Pager will remain assigned until monitoring window completes.
ajones: thanks everyone — keep command-room open until handoff. If error reappears escalate to platform lead
kevin: copying logs and deltas to incident ticket for root-cause analysis
maria: I'll draft customer follow-up with timeline + mitigation info after we complete RCA
ops-bot: scheduled rollback of temporary WAF rule at 6601234680 unless extended
ajones: closing command-room after 45m if stable. great work team. :thumbsup:
